offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes, mainly to individual homebuyers, across many US markets. Also develops residential lots, builds rental communities, and offers mortgage and title services through subsidiaries.

primary_products.value: single-family homes; townhomes; residential lots; multi-family and single-family rental communities

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title insurance and closing services; residential land development

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual homebuyers, including entry-level and move-up buyers; B2B: lot buyers, builders and institutional investors in rental communities

end_markets.value: residential construction; housing; residential real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: homes and lots sold to buyers; service fees: mortgage origination and title/closing fees; interest or premiums: title insurance premiums and mortgage-related income; rental or leasing: rental community operations
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; interest or premiums; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes using purchased land, materials and subcontracted labor, sold to homebuyers; asset operator: develops land and lots and owns rental communities; financial intermediary: originates mortgages and provides title services to its homebuyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US national: Homebuilding markets across many states in the East, Midwest, South Central, Southwest and West US

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding, lot development, rental communities, mortgage and title services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales staff at model homes and community sales offices; online: website and online home search and sales; agents / brokers: outside real estate brokers representing buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, building codes, environmental rules, mortgage subsidiary under CFPB and state lending rules
